messages:
alexg: Heads-up — spotted an embeddings request that should've been blocked by the per-route allowlist. Token was scoped to `payments-api` but the request was routed to `embed-large` and succeeded.

maria: @alexg ugh. Do you have the request id / logs?

alexg: req=01FZQH7X, token=tok_abc123. Log snippet:
```
authz: allowlist_check=false route=payments-api token_id=tok_abc123 model=embed-large key_tag=null decision=ALLOW
kms: key_id=projects/prod/keys/kr-42 rewrap=true tags=\"{}\"
```

security-bot: Alert created: SEC-2026-245 — possible per-route scope bypass (auto-detected).

jonathan: Hm. Key tag null + rewrap=true screams KMS rotate pipeline dropped route tag metadata during rewrap. We had a one-off like this when rewrap job skipped metadata on >1.2.0.

maria: Could be cache staleness too — authz checks read key tags from the KMS-metadata cache. If the rewrap invalidated the tag but cache still returns an older entry without the route tag, we treat it as permissive?

alexg: The code path: token -> fetch key_tag from metadata cache -> per-route allowlist match. The cache returns `{}` for tok_abc123. There is also a fallback that treats absent tag as legacy token and allows embeddings if token has embeddings-scope. Not ideal.

sean: Short term mitigation: change fallback to fail-closed for embeddings-per-route mismatch (i.e., block if tag missing and the route has an allowlist). Can we do a config toggle?

maria: Yes. I can push a toggle to `authz-config` to flip fail-open->fail-closed for per-route checks. Need a quick rollback plan.

jonathan: Longer term: fix the KMS rewrap job to preserve/propagate tags and add a write-through to invalidate the metadata cache on rotate. Also add an audit job to reconcile key tags vs route assignments.

alexg: Repro steps I used: 1) create token with route=payments-api 2) rotate key for that token via kms rewrap 3) make embeddings call using token -> passed. Happens 1/3 times in my test due to race between rewrap and cache refresh.

maria: I'll do the toggle now, post PR, and run the regression tests. Assigning myself.

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/authz-config/pull/987 (flip fail-open -> fail-closed for per-route allowlist). Will roll out to prod-edge then prod-core.

jonathan: I'll take KMS rewrap fix. Plan: ensure metadata copy step exists in rewrap tool, add `--preserve-tags` default, and add a cache invalidation hook. Estimate: hotfix in 6h, full regression & deploy tomorrow.

sean: Security ops: run audit query to list tokens with missing key_tag but active per-route restrictions. I can run that and post results.

security-bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-245 -> Priority P2. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/SEC/SEC-2026-245

alexg: Example audit query I used:
```
SELECT token_id FROM tokens t
LEFT JOIN kms_keys k ON t.key_id = k.key_id
WHERE k.tags->>'route' IS NULL AND t.route IS NOT NULL;
```

sean: Running audit now, will paste results in ~20m.

maria: Toggle deployed to prod-edge (canary). Monitoring metrics for blocked_embeddings_by_route. Rolling to prod-core in 10m if green.

jonathan: Hotfix branch pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kms-rewrap/compare/preserve-tags. Added cache invalidation webhook and unit tests.

sean: Audit finished: 12 tokens found in prod with missing `route` tag and per-route policies. I've added them to the incident tracker and notified owners.

alexg: Thanks everyone. Postmortem items: 1) enforce explicit tags on rotate, 2) change fallback semantics, 3) add e2e for rotate+authz race, 4) surface missing tags in token creation UI.

maria: Adding those items to SEC-2026-245 postmortem. I'll assign owners and ETA.

jonathan: Will ship hotfix to rewrap by EOD and schedule a deploy with seans ops window.

sean: Noted — I'll coordinate deploy window and follow up in the incident thread.

maria: Closing loop for now; prod canary looked good and we blocked the offending path. Reopen if any anomalies. :thumbsup:
